scope: Prioritized current FAST classical/preprocessing/ANN dispatch, KNN shared workspace, and selected known legacy shape controls. Searched product Mojo/Python; manually inspected listed source windows. Not an exhaustive call-graph or all-target audit.

non_product_categories: Benchmark recipe dataset splits/caps are coverage contracts, not product dispatch; full variant IDs preserve original capped recipes.
Consumed-output sampling/hashing is capture scope and must be reported separately from runtime routing.
ABI argument counts, enum opcodes, FP32 exact-index limit2^24 and hardware lane widths are not benchmark evidence by themselves.

receipt_flag_evidence.limitation: This flag scan covers retained native bindings only; do not extend to uninspected Apple/AMD artifact histories.
